name: charterion
description: Open-source multi-agent engineering control plane for ChatGPT Web Agents.

scripts.test:faults: vitest run tests/faultMatrix.test.ts tests/recovery.test.ts tests/contentRuntimeFence.test.ts tests/tabOperationQueue.test.ts tests/coalescingRunner.test.ts control/tests/controlPlane.test.ts --pool=forks --fileParallelism=false
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run check:control && npm run check:assets && npm run check:readme-i18n && npm run check:architecture && npm run test && npm run test:faults && npm run build && npm run check:dist && npm run build:control
scripts.release: npm run verify:full && npm run check:readme-i18n:release && node scripts/package-release.mjs && node scripts/package-runtime.mjs
scripts.smoke:native: npm run build:control && npm run publish:native && node scripts/smoke-native-host.mjs
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run publish:native && npm run smoke:control && npm run smoke:evidence && npm run smoke:change-request && npm run smoke:fleet && npm run smoke:native && npm run smoke:runtime-install && npm run smoke:launcher
